MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 9

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

9. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 4

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

12. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 169
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. A — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625
5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

4. A — 20
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 5
3. Product = 20
Final Answer: 20
